defect.proposed_fix: Keep the good_law status, but qualify the prose to say no adverse treatment is recorded in the lake as of 2026-06-30; note that proposed/mentioned progeny edges and a top-cited audit flag remain.

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law, as_of_treatment is 2026-06-30, varies_by_point is false, and point_overrides is empty.

residual_risks: The lake record has bounded progeny enumeration and a capped top-cited lane, so a full external treatment audit would be needed to make an unqualified no-negative-treatment statement.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use: 'Status: good law as of 2026-06-30. No adverse treatment is recorded in the lake; proposed/mentioned progeny edges remain pending audit.'
